svg.title: Technology stacks: Python, Go, web, and shared tools
svg.desc: Python: Python, FastAPI, Django, Django Ninja, Django REST Framework, asyncio, Celery, TaskIQ, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, PydanticAI, FastMCP, Pytest, Mypy; Go: Go, Echo; Web: JavaScript, HTML, CSS; Databases & storage: SQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, PostGIS, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Weaviate, MinIO; Messaging: RabbitMQ, Kafka; Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, Ansible, Nginx, Linux, S3, AWS; Delivery & automation: Git, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Danger, dependabot-gitlab; Identity & secrets: Keycloak, HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault; Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, Loki, Logfire; AI & agent tooling: Agent Skills, MCP, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph; Browser testing: Selenium, Playwright
